university.name: Ulster University
university.summary: Ulster University teaches on campuses in Belfast, Coleraine and Derry~Londonderry in Northern Ireland, and lists branch campuses in London, Birmingham and Manchester. It publishes 2027/28 international fees, a Pakistan country page and international scholarships.

courses.title: Computing Science (Conversion)
courses.duration_text: 1 year (12 months), three semesters, full time
courses.overview: A one-year full-time conversion master's for graduates, delivered at the Derry~Londonderry campus and open only to international applicants. The listed modules cover software development, software architecture, database systems and a project.
courses.academic_requirements: A second class honours degree or better from a recognised UK, Irish or equivalent institution, or an equivalent standard (normally 50%) in a graduate or postgraduate diploma or certificate. The qualification may have a maximum of 50% computing content. GCSE grade C or above, or equivalent, in English Language and Mathematics.
courses.english_requirements: Course page: Academic IELTS 6.0 with no band score less than 5.5. Ulster English language page: PTE Academic 59 with a minimum of 59 in each part; TOEFL iBT 80 (L17, R18, S20, W17) for tests taken before 21 January 2026; Duolingo English Test 110 with no subscore below 100 (taken after July 2024). PTE Academic Online is not accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan country page, postgraduate: 4-year Bachelor's equivalent to a UK Bachelor's, 65% for a 2:1 or 55% for a 2:2. Applications are not accepted from Khyber Pakhtunkhwa or Azad Jammu and Kashmir, applications must go through approved education agents, and a pre-deposit interview applies.
courses.notes: Course page states 2027/28 fees will be announced in due course; GBP 18,880 is the 2027/28 Masters rate on the fees page, which does not list this course among the selected MSc and LLM courses at GBP 21,130. The page says second class honours without stating upper or lower, so 2:2 is recorded as the lowest class. Fees are subject to annual increase. Modules listed are Year 1 and may change for year of entry.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 4 years including a work placement year (full time)
courses.overview: A four-year full-time undergraduate degree at the Derry~Londonderry campus, with the third year as a work placement. Year 1 modules include software development, database systems, computer hardware and operating systems, and mathematics for computing.
highlights: Core: Computer Hardware and Operating Systems
courses.academic_requirements: UK A Levels BBC (a two-grade drop for listed subjects such as Mathematics or Computer Science). International entry: grades CCC or higher, which may include course specific subjects; requirements vary by country. GCSE grade C/4 or above in Mathematics and English Language, or equivalent.
courses.english_requirements: Course page: Academic IELTS 6.0 with no band below 5.5, or an accepted alternative. Ulster English language page: PTE Academic 59 with a minimum of 59 in each part; TOEFL iBT 80 (L17, R18, S20, W17) for tests taken before 21 January 2026; Duolingo English Test 110 with no subscore below 100 (taken after July 2024). PTE Academic Online is not accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan country page, undergraduate Year 1 entry: HSSC / Intermediate with 75% overall; an associate degree (four semesters) or a 2-year Bachelor's at 55% or above. Applications are not accepted from Khyber Pakhtunkhwa or Azad Jammu and Kashmir, applications must go through approved education agents, and a pre-deposit interview applies.
courses.notes: Course page states 2027/28 fees will be announced in due course; GBP 18,030 is the 2027/28 undergraduate rate on the fees page and is subject to annual increase. The placement year is charged at GBP 4,900 on the fees page. Year 1 modules may change for year of entry.

courses.title: Business Economics
courses.duration_text: 3 years full time, or 4 years with a placement year
courses.overview: A three-year full-time undergraduate degree at the Belfast campus, with an optional placement year. Year 1 core modules cover microeconomic and macroeconomic principles, economics in practice, and mathematics and statistics.
highlights: Core: Mathematics and Statistics for Economics and Business
courses.academic_requirements: UK A Levels BBC (BCC with Maths, Further Maths, Physics, Economics or Accounting). International entry: grades BCC or higher, which may include course specific subjects; requirements vary by country. GCSE Maths grade C*/5 or above and English Language grade C/4 or above, or equivalent.
courses.english_requirements: Course page: Academic IELTS 6.0 with no band below 5.5, or an accepted alternative. Ulster English language page: PTE Academic 59 with a minimum of 59 in each part; TOEFL iBT 80 (L17, R18, S20, W17) for tests taken before 21 January 2026; Duolingo English Test 110 with no subscore below 100 (taken after July 2024). PTE Academic Online is not accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan country page, undergraduate Year 1 entry: HSSC / Intermediate with 75% overall; an associate degree (four semesters) or a 2-year Bachelor's at 55% or above. Applications are not accepted from Khyber Pakhtunkhwa or Azad Jammu and Kashmir, applications must go through approved education agents, and a pre-deposit interview applies.
courses.notes: Course page states 2027/28 fees will be announced in due course; GBP 18,030 is the 2027/28 undergraduate rate on the fees page and is subject to annual increase. The placement year is charged at GBP 4,900 on the fees page. Year 1 modules may change for year of entry.

scholarships.name: Global Excellence Scholarship (Postgraduate)
scholarships.summary: Automatically assessed award for international applicants with the equivalent of a UK 2:1 or above who hold an offer for a full-time taught programme on a Northern Ireland campus.
scholarships.criteria_text: Equivalent of a UK 2:1 or above; valid passport from a relevant country; offer for a full-time postgraduate taught programme on a Belfast, Coleraine or Derry~Londonderry campus; not part-time, eLearning or London, Birmingham or Manchester campuses. Scholarships are not cumulative.
scholarships.deadline_note: No separate application and no deadline stated; assessed when an offer is made.
scholarships.notes: Value for Pakistan taken from the Pakistan country page; the general scholarship page defers to country pages. min_pk_percent 65 is the Pakistan page's percentage for a 2:1.

scholarships.name: Global Excellence Scholarship (Undergraduate)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,000 in Year 1 and GBP 3,000 per academic year in Years 2 to 4
scholarships.summary: Automatically assessed award for international applicants with the equivalent of UK A-level BBB or above who hold an offer for a full-time undergraduate programme on a Northern Ireland campus.
scholarships.criteria_text: Equivalent of UK A-level BBB or above; valid passport from a relevant country; offer for a full-time undergraduate programme on a Belfast, Coleraine or Derry~Londonderry campus; not part-time, eLearning or branch campuses. Not applicable to the placement year. Scholarships are not cumulative.
scholarships.deadline_note: No separate application and no deadline stated; assessed when an offer is made.
scholarships.notes: Value for Pakistan taken from the Pakistan country page. The Pakistan percentage that equals BBB is not stated.

scholarships.name: Country Scholarship (Postgraduate)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 4,000 for postgraduate taught study (the general page says up to GBP 4,000)
scholarships.summary: Automatically assessed award for international applicants who meet the entry requirements and hold an offer for a full-time taught programme on a Northern Ireland campus.
scholarships.criteria_text: Meets the programme entry requirements; valid passport from a relevant country; offer for a full-time postgraduate taught programme on a Belfast, Coleraine or Derry~Londonderry campus; not part-time, eLearning or branch campuses. Scholarships are not cumulative.
scholarships.deadline_note: No separate application and no deadline stated; assessed when an offer is made.
scholarships.notes: Pakistan country page names it the Standard Country scholarship at GBP 4,000.

scholarships.name: Country Scholarship (Undergraduate)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 4,000 in Year 1 and GBP 2,000 per academic year in Years 2 to 4 (the general page says up to GBP 4,000 in Year 1)
scholarships.summary: Automatically assessed award for international applicants who meet the entry requirements and hold an offer for a full-time undergraduate programme on a Northern Ireland campus.
scholarships.criteria_text: Meets the programme entry requirements; valid passport from a relevant country; offer for a full-time undergraduate programme on a Belfast, Coleraine or Derry~Londonderry campus; not part-time, eLearning or branch campuses. Not applicable to the placement year. Scholarships are not cumulative.

scholarships.notes: Pakistan country page names it the Standard Country scholarship.

scholarships.name: International Postgraduate Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 2,000 discount applied to the tuition fee
scholarships.summary: Automatic discount for self-funding international students with an offer for a full-time postgraduate programme starting in September at the Belfast, Coleraine or Derry~Londonderry campus.
scholarships.criteria_text: Self-funding international student paying the international fee; full-time postgraduate programme starting in September on a Northern Ireland campus; not part-time, eLearning or branch campuses.
scholarships.deadline_note: No application needed and no deadline stated.
scholarships.notes: Page does not state an entry year. The Global Excellence page says scholarships are not cumulative with only one usable per application, so this is likely not stackable with the Country or Global Excellence awards.

scholarships.name: International Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 2,000 discount applied to the annual tuition fee, each year except a placement year
scholarships.summary: Automatic annual discount for self-funding international students with an offer for a full-time undergraduate programme starting in September at the Belfast, Coleraine or Derry~Londonderry campus.
